releases.head: fa2ed73
releases.ci: lint/typecheck/unit, registration, full-platform, roles over HTTPS full + registration (Chromium and WebKit): success
releases.local: registration 22; full Playwright 339 + stepped-join specs; built-page captures 1536×722@1.25, 1366×657, 1440×900, 390×844, 320×700 ar/en, no overflow
repairs: WebKit: controlled handle field wiped pre-hydration typing → uncontrolled; fields remount only for a saved draft
draft written on every change and on pagehide instead of a debounce
brochure-design and phone-country specs follow the steps

liveChecks.result: no overflow; step 1 fields and Continue on the first screen (320×700: Continue 70 px below the fold); rail beside the fields on laptop, compact above on phone; later fields hidden until reached; steps 2 and 3 reached with placeholder text; after leaving and returning the step and name are restored, the password field is empty and sessionStorage holds no password; nothing submitted, no account created

method: Headless Chromium from the build sandbox (viewport emulation, not physical devices); the sandbox proxy's intermittent 502s on static assets were retried and counted; placeholder text only, nothing submitted.
